derivation:
by
  simpa [chiCarry, chiVal, Nat.div_eq_of_lt, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt, ZMod.val_lt] using
    (Nat.add_div (a := chiVal χ g) (b := chiVal χ h) (Nat.pos_of_neZero N))
explanation: Nat.add_div gives the quotient of a sum as the individual quotients plus the carry indicator. Instantiating with the two character values, their bounds simplify the individual quotients to zero and their remainders to themselves.
